english: "B" was in the mine again. Didn't catch a glimpse of them, but the dredge are uneasy. Vova, one of the higher ranks, is especially anxious when our mystery benefactor is around.
"I SALUTE your efforts. That's why I sell these astral fluctuating masses. No slick-talking 'special deals' from me—wouldn't want to UPSET you, unlike that junior archivist." — Gharr
"Let me show you something!" —Firemarshall Bill Burns

"Olef asked his mother why his bowl was always filled last. She replied, 'The finest hunter can't feed her family unless she is fed first. In return, hunters leave no bowl empty. This, we learned from Owl.'"
"The largest eggs for the largest palettes," the chef always says. I think he means plates.
"Thought I was pullin' yer fins, didn't ya? I told ya. I tell... I tell no... I told ya the truth!" —"Captain" Lakes
"Where life goes, so too, should you."
